name: Union of Burma (Myanmar)
native: ပြည်ထောင်စုမြန်မာနိုင်ငံ (Pyidaungzu Myanma Naingngandaw)
alt: Socialist Republic of the Union of Burma
Republic of the Union of Myanmar

predecessors.name: British Raj
predecessors.text: British Burma, the last shape of Cliopatria's British Raj row (1947, 748,070 km2), which holds 2,261 Myanmar cells

ledger.x: 1948: Burma becomes an independent republic on 4 January 1948.

1962: General Ne Win seizes power on 2 March 1962, arresting U Nu and declaring a socialist state under the Union Revolutionary Council; the state, its name and its borders continue (the Burma Socialist Programme Party was founded on 4 July 1962).
1974: the Socialist Republic of the Union of Burma.
1989: Burma becomes the Union of Myanmar.
2005: the capital moves from Yangon to the new city later named Naypyidaw (The military moved the capital from Yangon in November 2005; named on 27 March 2006).

wars.name: Internal conflict in Myanmar
wars.outcome: No border change: Communist and ethnic insurgencies affected the early years, including the Karen National Union; after 1949 a Kuomintang army controlled remote areas of northern Burma.
